challenge.title: A Visit to the Masjid
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines at a masjid. Ask about the next prayer and the iqamah, find the wudu area and the entrance, deal with your shoes and phone, ask about the qibla, and say what happens when you arrive late. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 17 and keep the fixed Islamic wording exactly as it is.
required_elements: A question about the next prayer or the time of the iqamah, using شو or إيمتى.
A question about the wudu area or the entrance, using وين.
A request or reply about shoes on the rack (صباط) or the phone on silent (عالصامت).
A question about the qibla or a prayer rug.
A missed rak'ah explained with فاتتني, and a closing تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ with its reply مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ.
